# Solutions

**[id 80]** Each girl got 1/6 of 24 = 4 liters. Two girls got 8 liters total. Boy got 6 liters. Total given: 14 liters. Remaining: 24 - 14 = 10 liters.

**[id 81]** Charlie started with 10, bought 21, got 23 for birthday = 54 total. Gave away 9, used 28 = 37 removed. Remaining: 54 - 37 = 17 stickers.

**[id 82]** Grace weighs 125. Alex weighs 4(125) - 2 = 500 - 2 = 498. Combined: 125 + 498 = 623 pounds.

**[id 83]** 3 bushes × 25 roses/bush = 75 roses. 75 roses × 8 thorns/rose = 600 thorns.

**[id 84]** Let W = wins, L = losses. W + L = 22 and W = L + 8. So (L + 8) + L = 22, giving 2L = 14, L = 7, W = 15.

**[id 85]** Gene vacationed from age 23 to 34 = 11 years. At 4 vacations/year: 11 × 4 = 44 blocks.

**[id 86]** First alarm: 4 rings. Second: 3 × 4 = 12 rings. Third: 12 ÷ 2 = 6 rings. Total: 4 + 12 + 6 = 22 rings.

**[id 87]** Monthly salary $600, annual $7,200. After 5 years, eligible for 10% of initial annual salary increase per year = $720/year. After 3 more years: $7,200 + 3($720) = $9,360.

**[id 88]** Marilyn sold 10 times Harald's amount. 10H + H = 88,000, so 11H = 88,000, H = 8,000 copies.

**[id 89]** 16 invited guests need 16 × 0.75 = 12 gift bags. At $2 each: 12 × $2 = $24.
